title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode15 Are You Serious?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You won't perform anymore? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know you aren't any good with jokes, so stop messing around.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong? Did your old man say something again?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is my own decision. Our kind of music doesn't mean anything. It's just a bunch of kids making some noise.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you being serious right now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're the one who said I wasn't any good at making jokes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Our music has no meaning?
Try saying that again! I won't take this, not even from you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you gonna do if you quit, anyway? Go crawling back and let your dad control you again after saying how much you hated things? How is that any more meaningful?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Get back here! This conversation isn't over, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't you think it's about time you grew up and stopped chasing after some tiny event that no-one's even heard of outside of this town?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And never show your face around here again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hi there, you two! It's nice to see you.
Oh? You cut your hair.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Kohane, why'd you change your hair?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. It's proof of her resolve, right Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks to An and everyone's support, I managed to perform again. And it went great! Thank you so much for your help!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku, why are you guys taking such an interest in us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's because we want all of you to discover your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When that happens, they'll be transformed into a new song. Our wish is that such feelings will give birth to all kinds of new songs.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our feelings will change into a song...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why we've gotta make those other two who haven't been here yet realize their true feelings as well!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You mentioned this place was made from the feelings of four people. Do you know who the other two are?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We haven't had a chance to talk to them yet, but I'm sure Akito and Toya will come visit soon!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wh-What? Are they friends of yours?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
W-Well, I wouldn't exactly call them friends...
It's... complicated.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess they did both say they dreamt of surpassing RAD WEEKEND, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you've been singing around here a lot lately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nothing, I just noticed, that's all.
I was curious why you'd choose to sing here, of all places.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Your rhythm and pitch are always so precise.
I bet you've been into music a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh? Some kind of story behind it, I take it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel like I can be myself when I'm singing like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you've got music to thank for keeping you going, then?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Now I'm really interested.
Hey, how would you like to try singing together?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So you two decided to team up, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. There's one more thing we wanted to talk to you about. Care to have a guess?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've decided to call ourselves BAD DOGS.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What the heck, Toya?! I wanted to tell him!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then just say it. No reason to act so smug and drag it out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How is it that someone who talks as little as you always cuts in right at the worst time?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
S-So scary... Shinonome seems upset.
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm not sure. I was planning on telling him about the SEKAI, but he's been acting like that ever since he got here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I haven't seen him.
I wonder if they had a fight or something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It'll probably blow over soon. Oh, hey. One of the guys from a club nearby called SPACE asked me if we'd like to perform. What do you think? Want to do it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wonder if Shinonome and Aoyagi are all right.)
